cells.gaps: Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025 was validated at a 2019 workshop; no cabinet act is on record, and the ADN coordinator said in November 2023 that it was adopted in 2019 (COD-062). Its successors, the Politique sectorielle de l'economie numerique 2026-2030 (validated 4 Aug 2026, to go to the Council of Ministers; no action plan, steering body or monitoring yet) and the PNN2 2026-2030 (drafting or announced, costed, period 2026-2030), are not adopted. Reporting is a ministry estimate of 60% completion, not measured against targets. The two successors are not reconciled. A COMESA progress report of 1 Oct 2026 lists the launch of the 2026-2030 plan at USD 1 billion and names no adopting act or body.
cells.note: Instrument: Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025, adopted in 2019, whose period ended in 2025, with successor PSEN 2026-2030 validated but not adopted, so the cell is stage 2, lapsed. Stage 3 needs an adopted strategy inside its period.
